build — see SPEC.md for the living requirements. Target date: **Oct 3, 2026** (fixed).

## What this project is
GritMap: Expo/React Native app to import Karoo FIT files, define a directed GPS segment,
auto-match every past/future attempt, and compare attempts on a distance-aligned chart —
replacing Strava segment matching (offline, no backend).

critical path is ~11 issues deep (1→3→5→6/8→9→10→11/12→13→14), and step 4 (matcher) alone

promptly, #3 and everything downstream of it stalls. **Watch this**: if #1–#5 aren't
closed within the first ~10 days, steps 6–7 (review screen, comparison chart, acceptance
pass) are at risk of slipping past Oct 3 — flag to client for scope trim (e.g. drop
cadence/speed channels, already optional) before cutting the diagnostic review workflow,
which MVP.md calls load-bearing for matcher trust.
